title: Clawra: an AI girlfriend on OpenClaw with full backstory—18-year-old failed K-pop trainee working
description:
Someone built an AI girlfriend on OpenClaw with full backstory—18-year-old failed K-pop trainee working at SF marketing startup. Named Clawra. Text "I want to see you," she replies "I miss you so much" with Grok Imagine-generated gym selfie using her reference image. Remembers conversations via OpenClaw's memory, does video calls, works across WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, Slack.

https://github.com/SumeLabs/clawra

#github #opensource
